info.title: PG1 Sovereign Threat Intelligence API
info.description:
REST endpoints for PG1 Sovereign Threat Intelligence. This document only covers the plain HTTP GET endpoints below (/api/ioc and /api/health); the full tool catalog is also available over two JSON-RPC transports, which are not representable as REST paths:

- MCP (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC): https://pg1-ai-agent.vercel.app/api/mcp
- A2A (Agent2Agent, JSON-RPC 2.0): https://pg1-ai-agent.vercel.app/api/a2a — agent card at https://pg1-ai-agent.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json

/api/ioc is gated by one of: a Gumroad licence key (x-api-key header), a per-call x402 v2 micropayment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header), or the opt-in free tier (x-free-tier: 1 header, 5 calls/day per IP).

get.description: Returns a STIX 2.1 bundle of threat indicators. Requires a Gumroad licence key, a settled x402 v2 payment, or an opt-in free-tier request (subject to the 5 calls/day per IP limit).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO timestamp (e.g. 2026-09-20T00:00:00Z). Only indicators last seen after this time are returned.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Exact-match indicator type filter against the stored value.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of STIX objects to return.

parameters.name: x-free-tier
parameters.description: Opt in to the free tier: set to "1" to be considered for a free, unauthenticated, unpaid request. Limited to 5 calls/day per IP. Ignored if a licence key or payment is also present.

200.description: STIX 2.1 bundle of matching threat indicators.

items.description: A STIX 2.1 Indicator or Vulnerability object (Vulnerability for CVE records).

402.description: Payment required. Either a plain error object (no licence key, no payment offered, or the x402 facilitator is unreachable), or the full x402 v2 PaymentRequired challenge object (a payment was attempted and verification/settlement failed, or no payment was offered while x402 is configured) — in the latter case the same object is also base64-encoded in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header.

PAYMENT-REQUIRED.description: Base64-encoded x402 v2 PaymentRequired JSON object. Present when the x402 middleware issues the challenge.

Retry-After.description: Present when Gumroad licence verification is temporarily unavailable.

403.description: Forbidden: the supplied licence key is invalid, expired, or refunded.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. /api/ioc only serves GET, POST, HEAD, and OPTIONS.

500.description: Internal Server Error while building or serving the STIX bundle.

503.description: Threat data or licence verification is temporarily unavailable; retry shortly.

get.description: Public, ungated uptime check. Never consumes free-tier quota. Result is cached in memory for up to 30 seconds.

503.description: Service is degraded (Supabase reachability check failed).

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Gumroad licence key. A Bearer token in the Authorization header is also accepted as an alternative.

X402Payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
X402Payment.description: Signed x402 v2 payment payload for a $0.01 per-call micropayment on Base (eip155:8453). The X-Payment header name is also accepted.
